title: Material study
role: Material or craft detail supports a real physical claim.
cropRules: Preserve scale and color honesty; use selective magnification with context.
provenance: Do not use generated material as proof of manufacture or exact finish.
delivery: Choose actual output dimensions and format from the display role.
Use responsive sources and avoid blocking the primary action on nonessential art.
Record bytes, dimensions, source and transformations in the project asset manifest.
